use_cases: Animated hero section for creative agency or portfolio websites
Dynamic background visualization for landing pages
Interactive art installation display for digital galleries
Loading screen with generative mathematical animations
Visual effects component for streaming or media platforms
ai_summary: A generative art component that renders mathematical expressions as animated vortex-like visualizations. Uses canvas-based rendering with polar coordinate transformations to create hypnotic spiral patterns, snakes, space-time tunnels, and fractal nebula effects. The animations are time-driven with smooth morphing transitions between 18 distinct expression presets.
